name: long-running-tasks-plugin
description: Run explicit repository tasks directly or through a local, serial-first workflow as isolated, verifiable, recoverable Codex slices.

interface.shortDescription: Run or coordinate isolated, recoverable task slices.
interface.longDescription: Long-Running Tasks preserves the direct TASK.md/PLAN.md runner and adds a local serial-first workflow for triage, specs, tickets, provenance, immutable execution projections, reconciliation, checkpoints, and recovery.
interface.defaultPrompt: For explicit durable repository work, choose direct start_run or the local serial workflow; preserve isolated execution and inspect or recover retained runs without publishing changes.
